difficulty_reason: For a morphism of ringed spaces f: X to Y and an O_X-module F, the lemma identifies the higher direct images with the sheaves associated to the presheaves sending an open V to the cohomology of F on the inverse image of V, with the restriction maps coming from the displayed equation, and notes that the same holds for a bounded below complex (statement lines 591-603). The proof resolves F injectively and recalls that the higher direct image is by definition the cohomology sheaf of the pushed forward complex; because cohomology sheaves in the category of O_Y-modules are computed as associated sheaves of the presheaves of kernels modulo images, the presheaf in question is computed termwise, and identifying f_*I(V) with I(f^{-1}(V)) makes it exactly the cohomology of F on the inverse image (proof lines 605-626). The claim is H2: the content is the passage from the cohomology sheaf of a complex of modules to the associated presheaf, which the author writes out explicitly.
